title.zh: 将莱特省帕斯特拉纳市镇帕斯特拉纳市镇中学的名称变更为Juan Villablanca纪念中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Pastrana Municipal High School in the Municipality of Pastrana, Province of Leyte, to Juan Villablanca Memorial High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Pastrana Municipal High School in the Municipality of Pastrana, Province of Leyte, to Juan Villablanca Memorial High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Pastrana Municipal tại Thị trấn Pastrana, Tỉnh Leyte thành Trường trung học phổ thông Juan Villablanca Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pastrana Municipal ในเทศบาล Pastrana, จังหวัด Leyte เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Juan Villablanca Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Pastrana Municipal di Kotamadya Pastrana, Provinsi Leyte menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Juan Villablanca Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Pastrana Municipal di Perbandaran Pastrana, Wilayah Leyte menjadi Sekolah Menengah Juan Villablanca Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6805_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Pastrana Municipal High School in the Municipality of Pastrana, Province of Leyte, is hereby changed to Juan Villablanca Memorial High School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
